summary.text: Tracy Ehlert is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 79 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator, with a career in early childhood education.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Ehlert was born in San Bernardino, California.

She earned an associate degree in information systems management from Kirkwood Community College in 2007, an associate degree in early childhood education from Marshalltown Community College in 2012, a bachelor's degree in early childhood education from Ashford University in 2015, and a master's degree in early childhood education from Walden University in 2017.

Her career experience includes owning B2K Learning Center and working as a student support staff-interventionist with the Cedar Rapids Community School District, a level 3 instructor with Child Care Resource & Referral, and a continuing education instructor with Kirkwood Community College.
She has been affiliated with the National Association for Family Child Care, the National TEACH Early Childhood Alliance Council, and the Iowa Early Childhood Workforce Advisory Committee.
Ehlert won Iowa House District 70 in the November 6, 2018 general election, defeating Myra Matejka, and won re-election there in 2020.
She has represented District 79 since the 2022 redistricting, winning re-election in 2022 and again in 2024 over Barclay Woerner.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows her assigned to the Economic Growth, House Education, House Human Resources and Labor committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Barclay Woerner in the general election.
